rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3AB blastocyst, but it overstates visibility of a large blastocoel and cohesive TE; the image is somewhat collapsed/partially obscured, so some described features are inferred rather than clearly seen.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, endometrial thickness, sperm factors, and cycle context with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, especially around embryo quality versus uterine factors; minor issues include somewhat speculative quantitative adjustments and a few overconfident inferences.

Core assessment is broadly evidence-based, but several recommendations (intralipid, ERA for endometriosis without RIF, scratching, atosiban, TE grade B linked to placentation issues) are not well supported by major guidelines.
Provides clear next-step options for current transfer versus freeze-all/FET and future workup, though some suggested adjuncts are controversial and reduce overall clinical usefulness.
